verification_candidates.claim_text: Many people in tropical climates have parasites, making it a giant health issue.

verification_candidates.rationale: A prevalence claim about parasitic infection that could be checked against epidemiological data.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The body's cells are constructed from the food a person eats, and food is the only thing they have to build from.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The health of a person's 'terrain' determines how vulnerable they are to germs; a very healthy person has very low vulnerability and a lifetime of abuse makes one highly vulnerable.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: The health of the terrain dictates how vulnerable you are to the germs, and a very healthy person has very low vulnerability
verification_candidates.rationale: A causal claim about infection susceptibility that bears on whether people rely on vaccines or lifestyle.
